items.text: Bears planning to start QB Caleb Williams vs Falcons after full week of practice without setbacks from torn hamstring; listed questionable but took starter reps.
items.why: Full practice week, no setbacks; sources confirm plan to start.
items.implication: QB upgrade for CHI pass-catchers; solid streaming spot vs ATL.
items.opportunity: Normal starter snaps/usage restored; boosts Odunze/Burden/Moore etc if applicable.

items.text: Eagles officially placed QB Jalen Hurts on injured reserve due to blood clot in calf after consultations with doctors; out for foreseeable future. Tanner McKee will start.
items.why: Blood clot discovered; IR placement official Saturday after multi-doctor review.
items.implication: McKee starts ROS short-term; Eagles offense downgraded, pass-catchers and remaining RBs face uncertainty but volume possible in vacuum.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for healthy PHI pass-catchers; Dameon Pierce lead RB snaps/carries with Barkley/Shipley also out.

items.text: Patriots officially activated WR A.J. Brown from IR to 53-man roster; expected to play Sunday vs Jets after practicing this week from high-ankle sprain.
items.why: Activated after limited practice week; Pelissero/Schefter/Rapoport confirm expected play.
items.implication: Immediate WR2 start value vs Jets; monitors snap share/routes post-ankle.
items.opportunity: Full route/target share upside if no setback; NE WR hierarchy boost.

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT (hamstring) for Week 6 along with Will Shipley; Eagles backfield to Dameon Pierce (4th-string previously).
items.why: Hamstring; ruled out Friday list and confirmed.
items.implication: Pierce leads carries/snaps in plus CAR matchup but limited offense overall with Hurts out.
items.opportunity: Pierce goal-line/early-down volume; reverse any prior Saquon beneficiaries.

items.text: Assuming AJ Brown active for Patriots he'll be active for me; starting him as WR2 wherever rostered. Also push pickup Tanner McKee if need QB—gonna be better than think, not worried about any Eagles skill players with him.
items.implication: WR2 start lock if active; McKee streamer viable, PHI weapons safe.
items.opportunity: AJB routes/targets as primary; McKee volume to Smith/Goedert/Wicks.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) unclear as questionable; highly doubt legit high-ankle given practice this week but no clue really, hoping more info. Friday Q list; Berry notes high-ankle diagnosis yet practiced, possible Thursday focus.
items.why: Practiced despite high-ankle report; Levitan skeptical of severity; NE has Thursday game next.
items.implication: Game-time; if out, NE RB committee (Stevenson lead?); if in, monitor snaps/carries cautiously.
items.opportunity: If OUT: Rhamondre Stevenson/full backfield volume; if IN limited: still risk.

items.text: Tanner McKee will have PHI's 4th-string RB (Dameon Pierce) but top-4 pass-catchers healthy: DeVonta Smith, Goedert, Wicks, Lemon. Unclear on AJ Brown/Henderson/DJ Moore Qs; Warren Friday Q add; Caleb/Metcalf/Olave/Dowdle more probable.
items.why: Healthy top pass-catchers despite thin RB and McKee start; PIT thin at WR expecting heavy 2-WR Metcalf sets.
items.implication: Start Smith/Goedert confidently; Metcalf target hog; Warren monitor groin; Qs lean playable for probable group.
items.opportunity: PHI pass-catcher routes/targets full; PIT Metcalf snap/target monopoly in 2-WR; Pierce RB volume.

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 6 (ankle); Tyler Huntley expected to start for Ravens.
items.implication: Ravens offense downgrade; Flowers/Andrews/Henry usage shifts under backup.
items.opportunity: Potential checkdown/volume bump for Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Derrick Henry in pass game.

items.text: Breece Hall OUT (quad) Week 6; AD Mitchell also OUT for Jets.
items.implication: Jets RB committee/backups elevated; Wilson target share stable or up.
items.opportunity: Backup RB carries/snaps; possible Garrett Wilson route volume if game script negative.

items.text: Rashee Rice OUT (hamstring) Week 6 along with Tyquan Thornton for Chiefs.
items.implication: Xavier Worthy and others see target/route increase; Kelce stable.
items.opportunity: Worthy/ Hollywood-type or remaining KC WRs snap/target share expansion.

items.text: DeVonta Smith IN (removed from report); Ladd McConkey, CeeDee Lamb, Ashton Jeanty, Quentin Johnston, Michael Penix IN. Ja'Kobi Lane activated from IR and expected to play for Ravens vs Browns. Jeremiyah Love OUT.
items.why: Friday ETR list + Schefter activation for Lane; Love ankle rest.
items.implication: Smith full go with McKee; McConkey/Jeanty/Lamb clear; Lane depth for BAL; Love absence boosts ARI backs/WRs.
items.opportunity: Smith routes full; Lane possible snaps/targets; ARI RB opportunity (e.g. others).

items.text: Loves Kyren Williams vs ARI (RB5) for elite recent usage and soft run defense leaking yards.
items.why: Volume elite lately; ARI run D soft.

items.text: Loves Drake London vs CHI (WR6) for bankable usage; also Mike Evans, George Kittle vs WSH soft pass D, Javonte Williams, Rhamondre Stevenson, Brock Purdy.
items.why: Usage reliable for London; WSH D buffet for Evans/Kittle; volume + soft run D for Javonte/Rhamondre; high-scoring for Purdy.
items.implication: Start with confidence in favorable spots/roles.

items.text: Hates Jaylen Waddle vs SEA (tough matchup), Emeka Egbuka vs PIT, Kyle Pitts vs CHI (shaky QB/feed), J.K. Dobbins vs SEA, Bo Nix vs SEA, Justin Herbert @ KC (low totals/ruts).
items.why: Ugly matchups (SEA pass/run D elite), shaky QB situations, low team totals, recent feed struggles.
items.implication: Sit/fade in most formats; pivot to better spots.
items.opportunity: Suppressed targets/carries/routes expected vs tough Ds or poor scripts.
